pages.text: Essences are consumed to gain Raidborn's permanent alliance effects. They are created with the $(l:raidborn:mechanics/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$(/l).
pages.title: Essences

pages.text: $(thing)Raidborn Essence$() grants Illager Loyalty and 5 recruitment slots by default.
pages.title: Raidborn Essence

pages.text: $(thing)Savage Essence$() grants Illager Honor and 10 recruitment slots by default.
pages.title: Savage Essence

pages.text: $(thing)Overlord Essence$() grants Hero of the Illage and 15 recruitment slots by default.
pages.title: Overlord Essence
